IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PROVIDES SERVICES, GRANTS, AND SCHOLARSHIPS FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE DEVELOPMENTALLY DISABLED, PROVIDES HELP FUNDS AND FUNDING TO CONFERENCES, TRAINING AND ACTIVITIES FOR PERSONS WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES.
IRS990.MissionDesc: OUR MISSION IS TO GENERATE AND DISTRIBUTE FUNDS TO INNOVATIVE PROGRAMS THAT ENHANCE THE QUALITY OF LIFE FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH INTELLECTUAL AND DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES IN SAN DIEGO AND IMPERIAL COUNTIES.
IRS990.Desc: TO CONTRIBUTE TO THE GENERAL WELFARE OF SOCIETY BY PROVIDING ASSISTANCE TO PERSONS RESIDING IN CALIFORNIA WHO HAVE DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES OR ARE AT RISK OF DEVELOPMENTAL DELAY OR DISABILITIES AND THEIR FAMILIES THROUGH FACILITATING AND AUGMENTING THE COORDINATION OF SERVICES AND PROGRAMS OF SAN DIEGO REGIONAL CENTER OF WHICH BENEFITS CLIENTS OF THE SAN DIEGO REGIONAL CENTER, WHICH AIDS AND ASSISTS THE DEVELOPMENTALLY DISABLED. PROVIDES SERVICES AND SCHOLARSHIPS FOR THE DEVELOPMENTALLY DISABLED, PROVIDED PERSONS WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES HELP FUNDS, AND PROVIDED FUNDING FOR CONFERENCES AND TRAINING FOR PERSONS WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: THE SUPPORTED ORGANIZATIONS ARE NOT LISTED BY NAME IN THE SAN DIEGO IMPERIAL COUNTIES DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICECS FOUNDATION'S (FOUNDATION) ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION. THE SUPPORTED ORGANIZATIONS ARE DECRIBED ONLY BY CLASS. THAT IS, ONLY ORGANIZATIONS THAT 1) PROVIDE SERVICES AND/OR ASSISTANCE TO INDIVIDUALS WHO ARE AT RISK FOR DEVELOPMENTAL DELAYS OR DISABILITIES OR WHO ARE DEVELOPMENTALLY DISABLED, AND THEIR FAMILIES, AND/OR 2) PROVIDE EDUCATION OR TRAINING TO INDIVIDUALS PURSUING CAREERS IN CHILDDEVELOPMENT, DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES AND RELATED FIELDS. ALL MUST RESIDE IN SAN DIEGO AND/OR IMPERIAL COUNTY, CALIFORNIA.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SAN DIEGO-IMPERIAL COUNTIES DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES FOUNDATION IS ORGANIZED AS A CALIFORNIA NONPROFIT CORPORATION AND HAS BEEN RECOGNIZED BY THE IRS AS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME TAXES UNDER IRC SECTION 501(A) AS AN FOUNDATION DESCRIBED IN IRC SECTION 501(C)(3), QUALIFIES FOR THE CHARITABLE CONTRIBUTION DEDUCTION, AND HAS BEEN DETERMINED NOT TO BE A PRIVATE FOUNDATION. THE FOUNDATION IS ANNUALLY REQUIRED TO FILE A RETURN OF FOUNDATION EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAX (FORM 990) WITH THE IRS. IN ADDITION, IT IS SUBJECT TO INCOME TAX ON NET INCOME THAT IS DERIVED FROM BUSINESS ACTIVITIES THAT ARE UNRELATED TO THEIR EXEMPT PURPOSES. THE FOUNDATION HAS DETERMINED THAT THEY ARE NOT SUBJECT TO UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME TAX AND HAVE NOT FILED AN EXEMPT FOUNDATION BUSINESS INCOME TAX RETURN (FORM 990-T) WITH THE IRS.
